dataset.name: Vocadito: a dataset of solo vocals with f0, note, and lyric annotations

split_policy.analysis_latency_policy: fixed 2048-sample analysis-window center for both detectors; no per-track tuning
split_policy.label: all-split
split_policy.note_chart_quantization: annotation Hz converted to MIDI and rounded half-up with floor(midi + 0.5); human frame-level F0 remains unrounded
split_policy.note_score_policy: production hit columns aggregated by eligible 20 ms note frames, normalized to 10000; excludes line bonus

score_detector_plus_four_semitones_contr.control_type: modeled measured MIDI + 4 semitones; not a second audio pass
